results.title: Fairphone Gen 6+ with /e/OS: De-Googled Modular Phone at €699
results.content:
News

Fairphone has launched the Gen 6+ paired with Murena's /e/OS, a de-Googled Android alternative priced at €699 / £599 / $699 and available now in Europe with a back-order in the US. The mid-cycle refresh bumps RAM to 12 GB and adds the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4, while retaining the modular chassis that lets you swap 12 components with a single screwdriver. /e/OS V4 ships out of the box, replacing Google's ecosystem with Murena's cloud suite, App Lounge, and a five-year warranty that extends support through at least 2033. It's a notably pricey commitment for a mid-tier chipset, but the combination of ethical sourcing, repairability, and a turnkey privacy-first OS makes it one of the few mainstream smartphones actually designed to outlive its owner. [...] The standard version runs Stock Android 16 with Fairphone's in-house gallery app, Google Play Store, Maps, Photos, and Gmail. It's available via AT&T and T-Mobile in the US. The /e/OS version, meanwhile, ships with the App Lounge, Magic Earth maps, and the Murena Workspace cloud suite for email, file/photo storage, and calendar/contact/task/note sync. It's available on back-order in the US via murena.com only, with no official carrier support listed.

The warranty covers 5 years of hardware and software updates through at least 2033, with Fairphone committing to Android OS updates until 2032 (8 years total from Gen 6 launch) plus security patches through 2033. /e/OS may continue development beyond that window, but the "possibly longer" claim remains unquantified. [...] ### Fairphone (Gen 6+) with /e/OS: A De-Googled Alternative to Apple and Google Lock-In

Fairphone has unveiled the Fairphone (Gen 6+) paired with Murena's /e/OS, a European-built modular smartphone designed to replace Google and Apple ecosystems "for good." The device launches at €699 / £599 / $699, available now in Europe and on back-order in the USA via murena.com.

The announcement arrives exactly one year after Fairphone's Gen 6 launched in June 2025. This mid-cycle refresh brings 12 GB of RAM (up from 8 GB on the original), a newer Qualcomm Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, and a new Cobalt Blue colorway tied to fair-mining commitments. It's not just a spec bump, it's a statement about what a smartphone can be when you strip out the tracking.
